words.definitionEn: a member of your family
words.exampleEn: All my relatives came to the wedding.

words.definitionEn: the son of your brother or sister
words.exampleEn: My nephew is five years old.

words.definitionEn: to stop sleeping
words.exampleEn: I wake up at six every day.

words.definitionEn: in the way that most often happens
words.exampleEn: I usually have tea for breakfast.

words.definitionEn: an area of knowledge studied at school
words.exampleEn: My favourite subject is English.

words.definitionEn: work teachers give students to do at home
words.exampleEn: I do my homework in the evening.

words.definitionEn: with many clouds in the sky
words.exampleEn: It's cloudy today, take an umbrella.

words.definitionEn: very good to eat
words.exampleEn: My grandmother cooks delicious plov.

words.definitionEn: to succeed in doing something after effort
words.exampleEn: She achieved her goal of getting B2.

words.definitionEn: to make or become better
words.exampleEn: Reading every day improves your vocabulary.
words.exampleUz: Har kuni o'qish so'z boyligingizni yaxshilaydi.

words.definitionEn: information and understanding you have learned
words.exampleEn: His knowledge of grammar is impressive.

words.definitionEn: to officially ask for a job or place
words.exampleEn: I want to apply for a scholarship.

words.definitionEn: knowledge or skill from doing something
words.exampleEn: This job requires two years of experience.
words.exampleUz: Bu ish ikki yillik tajriba talab qiladi.

words.definitionEn: travelling from one place to another
words.exampleEn: The journey to Samarkand takes two hours.
words.exampleUz: Samarqandga safar ikki soat davom etadi.

words.definitionEn: a place to stay or live
words.exampleEn: The price includes accommodation and meals.
words.exampleUz: Narxga turar joy va ovqat kiradi.

words.definitionEn: good for your health
words.exampleEn: Eating fruit is a healthy habit.

words.definitionEn: a piece of equipment for a particular purpose
words.exampleEn: Smartphones are powerful learning devices.

words.definitionEn: damage to air, water or land
words.exampleEn: Air pollution is a serious problem in big cities.
words.exampleUz: Havo ifloslanishi katta shaharlarda jiddiy muammo.

words.definitionEn: the subjects included in a course of study
words.exampleEn: The new curriculum focuses on practical skills.
words.exampleUz: Yangi o'quv dasturi amaliy ko'nikmalarga qaratilgan.

words.definitionEn: to judge the quality or level of something
words.exampleEn: Teachers assess students' progress monthly.

words.definitionEn: large or important enough to have an effect
words.exampleEn: There has been a significant increase in tourism.

words.definitionEn: to help cause something to happen
words.exampleEn: Everyone should contribute to protecting nature.
words.exampleUz: Tabiatni asrashga har kim hissa qo'shishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: a chance to do something good
words.exampleEn: Speaking English opens many opportunities.
words.exampleUz: Ingliz tilida gapirish ko'p imkoniyatlar ochadi.

words.definitionEn: in addition (formal)
words.exampleEn: The course is effective. Furthermore, it is free.
words.exampleUz: Kurs samarali. Bundan tashqari, u bepul.

words.definitionEn: despite what has just been said
words.exampleEn: The exam was hard; nevertheless, she passed.
words.exampleUz: Imtihon qiyin edi; shunga qaramay, u o'tdi.

words.definitionEn: something that exists and can be observed
words.exampleEn: Online learning is a global phenomenon.

words.definitionEn: including everything that is necessary
words.exampleEn: The platform offers comprehensive exam preparation.
words.exampleUz: Platforma keng qamrovli imtihon tayyorgarligini taklif qiladi.

words.definitionEn: certain to happen, unavoidable
words.exampleEn: Mistakes are an inevitable part of learning.

words.definitionEn: causing much disagreement
words.exampleEn: AI in education remains a controversial topic.

words.definitionEn: very convincing or interesting
words.exampleEn: She presented a compelling argument.
